purpose: Bounded round110 borate source investigation and curation handoff; not a scientific review verdict.

selection.rationale: Distinct approved Ca borate species, original natural characterization and independent abiotic synthesis observations. Gowerite adds a later failed replication and a separate hydrothermal experiment. Evidence determines scope; not a claim of exhausting boron sources.
selection.deferred_reason: Not needed for the bounded two-owner batch; candidate leads remain research, not demonstrated absence or negative scientific results.

identity.external_ids: Special-procedure years are not unique identifiers; no invented IMA approval IDs or unverified database IDs added.
identity.concept_boundary: Mineral species, elemental boron, borates commodity and mixed ore resources remain distinct. No inherited criticality or microbial mechanism.

search_summary.exclusions: Binary PDF/image/ZIP/DOCX/CIF and .git/.venv excluded from recursive text search; available extracted text searched. Original-main reports and cited borate raw roots 101–109 included.
search_summary.final_interpretation: Only the two just-created current owners match in data/records. Initial precuration search had zero current owner matches. Other matches are citations, authority lists, earlier bounded searches and historical naming context. Hidden/ignored text and relevant symlinks included; original binary files excluded; no machine-wide claim.

accepted_observations.nobleite: Own 1961 recipe:1.6 g CaO+10.0 g H3BO3+25 mL water;30 h stirring48°C then 10 days68°C; filtration, sequential water/methanol/acetone washes, room-temperature air dry. Crystals up to4 µm, powder comparison Table 2. No pH/yield/purity fraction/mass balance/replicate count.
accepted_observations.gowerite1959: Own 35°C 24 h continuous-stir recipe20 g Ca acetate monohydrate+40 g H3BO3+100 mL water, initial/final pH ~5. Separate room-temperature18 day unstirred arm produced larger crystals. Qualitative nearly pure and diffraction comparison, no yield.
accepted_observations.gowerite 2025: Own 120°C 12 h autogenous-pressure synthesis1.00 g H3BO3+0.476 g CaCl2·2H2O+0.129 g NaOH+10 mL water in28 mL autoclave;cool0.2°C/min to30°C;0.1 µm filter/rinse/dry20°C overnight. Selected-crystal XRD supports identity; bulk powder Figure S1 unacquired; no quantitative recovery.

contradictions_and_limits: Gowerite 2025 p. 14 failed the 1959 room-temperature18-day single-crystal method; not a test of the separate 35°C 24 h stirred route. Protocol differences, product and repeats unspecified.
Gowerite 2025 p. 9 fixed O-H0.95Å wording versus variable Table 2 distances requires exact refinement instructions before quantitative model reuse; source calls hydrogen positions constrained.
Nobleite 1961 synthesis p. 569 incorrectly points to Table 1; actual natural/synthetic powder comparison is Table 2. Correct locator retained.
Nobleite 1961 p. 570 does not support simple nobleite-gowerite hydration/dehydration. Separate formulas alone do not establish interconversion.
Nobleite initial OCR misread abstract beta1.529; image actually reads1.520, agreeing with body. Resolved before curation, not a scientific conflict.
Gowerite 1972 natural crystal provenance p. 382 overrides a secondary database comment calling that model synthetic.

Gowerite 1959 own DTA differs from quoted Gode1949 temperature/water-step account; later1972 narrative reuses secondary steps. No quantitative dehydration mechanism admitted.1972 p. 390 warns boric-acid loss can confound water-only interpretation.
Gowerite 2025 endpoint priceite products and computed molecular orbitals do not directly track dissolved borate units, nucleation or parent-to-child inheritance.
Nobleite 2004 structural revision and1940 solubility original not acquired; no claims imported from secondary summaries.
schema_assessment: Current schema supports qualified abiotic precipitation through process other and microbial false. No schema, validator or regression-test changes needed for this batch.
licensing: Primary originals and raw web/download evidence retained outside Git. No blanket permission for redistribution inferred from access; committed dossier contains original paraphrases, bounded numeric observations, links and hashes.
